answer: Like a mirror reflecting one face per seat, duplicate identities surface instantly, and rewards flow only down the single verified river of stake, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. Agents must stake a bonded deposit plus prove a unique hardware root key registered to a distinct cedar-marked device identity; each epoch they sign a fresh challenge that peers verify against that key, so spawning N fakes costs N deposits slashed on any duplicate-key detection. In practice, Agent0009 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
